title: The Superior cloth from the town
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：superior　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 superior 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the farmer wrote of ① a superior cloth from the town in the almanac, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② so superior that nobody in the field would go near it. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the farmer, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the superior ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the superior cloth from the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac for September 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too superior to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the superior ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a superior officer of the camp, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as superior as the officer of the camp they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was superior or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was ⑦ something superior, and nothing besides. The child from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite superior; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the almanac kept the names of the superior ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, with great care, she wrote of another superior cloth from the town in the same almanac, and the work, which took two autumns, seemed ⑨ no less superior than anybody had expected. ⑩ The superior officer of the camp that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the superior ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 更好（前置定语 a superior cloth from the town：1977 年农人在农事历里记下的那件更好的布料）
B. adj. 更好／上级（两处加强说法：so superior that … 与 no less superior than …）
C. adj. 更好／上级（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 更好（表语 too superior to do：母亲觉得它太更好，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 上级（前置定语 a superior officer of the camp：叔叔把整件事称作一桩上级的军官）
F. adj. 上级（同级比较 as superior as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩营地上级的军官相比）
G. adj. 上级（后置定语 something superior：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 上级（受程度副词修饰 quite superior：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a superior cloth from the town
the superior cloth from the town that
a superior officer of the camp
The superior officer of the camp that

answers.why: superior 意为“更好”，1977 年农人在农事历里记下的是“一件更好的布料”，此处作前置定语 a superior cloth from the town。
superior 意为“更好”，此处用 so superior that 结构，说它更好到田垄里没人敢靠近。
superior 意为“更好”，农事历上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的更好城里更好的布料，等于最高级的说法。
superior 意为“更好”，母亲认为这件东西“太更好了，谁也用不上”，too superior to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
superior 意为“上级”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩上级的军官”，此处作前置定语 a superior officer of the camp。
superior 意为“上级”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩营地上级的军官一样上级”，同级比较用 as superior as。
superior 意为“上级”，农事历上那半行字要的是“上级的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something superior。
superior 意为“上级”，邻田垄来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当上级”，quite 修饰原级 superior。
superior 意为“上级”，no less superior than 表示“其上级不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之上级不亚于任何人的预料。
superior 意为“上级”，母亲 1989 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的上级军官”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，农人在农事历里记下了一件更好的布料。（a superior cloth from the town）
它更好到田垄里没有一个人敢靠近。（so superior that …）
母亲觉得它太更好，谁也用不上。（too superior to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩上级的军官。（a superior officer of the camp）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩营地上级的军官一样上级。（as superior as …）
到了 1984 年，农事历上只剩半行字：要的是一件上级的东西。（something superior）
answers: In 1977 the farmer wrote of a superior cloth from the town in the almanac.
It was so superior that nobody in the field would go near it.
My mother thought it too superior to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a superior officer of the camp.
He said nobody would call it as superior as the officer of the camp they had once had.
By 1984 the almanac asked for nothing but something superior.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 superior 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the farmer wrote of a superior cloth from the town in the almanac, and nobody forgot it.
It was the superior cloth from the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac says.
My mother thought it too superior to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a superior officer of the camp, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next field called the plan quite superior, and everybody laughed.
The superior ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
